description: Search youth programs in the California cities Kyds Activities serves, one city at a time (`city` slug, defaults to Lodi). Filters: free-text query (program name or description), category (Sports, Music, Arts, Academics, Swimming and others), child age in years, free-only, or season. Returns up to 15 matching programs with cost, schedule, location, registration status and a link to each listing.

age.description: Child age in years. Returns programs whose age range includes this age.

category.description: Program category. Common values: Sports, Music, Arts, Academics, Swimming, Gymnastics, Dance, Enrichment, Free Programs.

city.description: City slug to search in, such as 'lodi', 'galt' or 'elk-grove'. Defaults to Lodi.

free_only.description: If true, only return programs with $0 cost.

query.description: Free-text search across program name + description (case-insensitive substring match).

name: search_programs
title: Search programs
